record.question:
Which of the following events ultimately triggered Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s resignation
    announcement on June 22, 2026?
options: The passing of a successful Vote of No Confidence by the Conservative Party
A decisive by-election victory in Makerfield by his political rival, Andy Burnham
A devastating defeat in the 2026 United Kingdom general election
The formal dissolution of Parliament by the Monarch
